% Project macros, read by main.tex through \input{macros}.
% Hover/live-preview renderers must pick these up to render formulas correctly.

% ---- 0 arguments ----
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\N}{\mathbb{N}}
\newcommand{\Prob}{\mathbb{P}}
\newcommand{\sigmaF}{\mathcal{F}}
\newcommand{\dd}{\mathop{}\!\mathrm{d}}
\newcommand*{\iid}{\stackrel{\text{i.i.d.}}{\sim}}

% ---- 1 argument ----
\newcommand{\norm}[1]{\left\lVert #1 \right\rVert}
\newcommand{\abs}[1]{\left\lvert #1 \right\rvert}
\newcommand{\vect}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\newcommand{\set}[1]{\left\{ #1 \right\}}

% ---- 2 arguments ----
\newcommand{\inner}[2]{\left\langle #1, #2 \right\rangle}
\newcommand{\pdv}[2]{\frac{\partial #1}{\partial #2}}

% ---- optional argument ----
% \E{X} -> E[X];  \E[Q]{X} -> E_Q[X]
\newcommand{\E}[2][]{\mathbb{E}_{#1}\left[ #2 \right]}
% \KL{P}{Q} or \KL[\text{fwd}]{P}{Q}: three parameters, the first optional
\newcommand{\KL}[3][]{D_{\mathrm{KL}}^{#1}\left( #2 \,\middle\|\, #3 \right)}
% optional argument with a non-empty default
\newcommand{\loss}[1][\theta]{\mathcal{L}(#1)}

% ---- operators ----
\DeclareMathOperator{\Var}{Var}
\DeclareMathOperator{\Cov}{Cov}
\DeclareMathOperator{\tr}{tr}
\DeclareMathOperator{\rank}{rank}
\DeclareMathOperator*{\argmin}{arg\,min}
\DeclareMathOperator*{\argmax}{arg\,max}

% ---- mathtools (MathJax has no \DeclarePairedDelimiter) ----
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\ceil}{\lceil}{\rceil}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter{\floor}{\lfloor}{\rfloor}

% ---- plain TeX definitions ----
\def\eps{\varepsilon}
\def\T{^{\mathsf{T}}}
\def\given{\mid}
\let\oldphi\phi
\renewcommand{\phi}{\varphi}

% ---- text-mode helpers ----
\newcommand{\term}[1]{\textbf{\emph{#1}}}
\newcommand{\zhen}[2]{#1（#2）}
